title: Hero input
search: Search heroes · Enter to add · / to focus
hint_enemies: Click a hero to put it in the matching enemy slot. Click again to remove.
hint_allies: Click a hero to put it in the matching ally slot (random teammates first). For your own hero, click your slot first.

why_picked: Already picked heroes can't be banned
why_banRoleFull: No more bans for this role
